backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the backend canister with user profile management, URL favorites, and song favorites, all gated by role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three music-related features (Jamendo API integration, fallback tracks, and useMusicSearch hook updates) to their implementation files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for components, pages, hooks, and data files in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the Kitsch-io SPA, mounting the React app at the `#root` div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Query, TanStack Router with all application routes, the MusicPlayerProvider context, and the persistent MusicPlayer component.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Modal dialog for adding a song to an existing playlist or creating a new one, using the usePlaylists hook and showing confirmation feedback on success.
frontend/src/components/GameCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a browser game's title, category badge, description, and an external Play Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/GameModal.tsx: A modal overlay component that renders a browser game with a header showing the game's title, emoji, and category, and closes on Escape key or backdrop click.
frontend/src/components/games/BreakoutGa: A canvas-based Breakout game with paddle, ball, and brick collision logic, tracking score and lives with win/loss states.
frontend/src/components/games/MemoryMatc: A memory card matching game using emoji pairs, tracking flips, matches, and move count with a shuffle-on-new-game feature.
frontend/src/components/games/Platformer: A canvas-based side-scrolling platformer where the player jumps between platforms to collect stars, with keyboard controls and win detection.
A canvas-based Snake game with grid rendering, interval-driven movement, food spawning, collision detection, and keyboard direction controls.
frontend/src/components/games/TicTacToeG: A two-player Tic-Tac-Toe game with win/draw detection and a reset button, rendered as a 3x3 grid of clickable cells.
frontend/src/components/games/WordleGame: A Wordle clone using a music-themed word list, supporting keyboard input with color-coded correct/present/absent letter feedback over six guesses.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app layout component providing a fixed background texture with overlay, a header with navigation links, and a personalization panel toggle for customizing the site style.
frontend/src/components/MovieCard.tsx: A card component displaying a movie's title, year, genre, synopsis, and a 'Watch Now' link button.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: A fixed bottom music player bar with playback controls, progress bar, volume control, album art, and song info sourced from the MusicPlayerContext.
frontend/src/components/PersonalizationP: A modal panel that lets users select from a list of background wallpaper textures and adjust the overlay opacity for site personalization.
frontend/src/components/ShowCard.tsx: A card component displaying a TV show's title, episode count, genre, description, and a styled 'Watch Now' link.
frontend/src/components/SongCard.tsx: A card component for a song that supports playback via MusicPlayerContext, favoriting, and adding to a playlist, with album art, now-playing indicator, and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/TrackCard.tsx: A simple card component displaying a music track with title, artist, genre, an inline HTML audio player, and an optional source link.
frontend/src/components/widgets/ClockWid: A small clock widget that displays the current time (HH:MM with seconds) and date, updating every second via setInterval.
frontend/src/components/widgets/Favorite: A widget component that displays a list of user-saved favorite links with add and remove functionality, backed by React Query hooks for data fetching and mutation.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MoodBoar: A widget that lets users select and persist a current mood from a predefined list of emoji/label pairs, storing the selection in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MusicTic: A static display widget that shows a horizontally scrolling ticker of hardcoded classical music track names.
frontend/src/contexts/MusicPlayerContext: A React context provider that manages global music playback state including current song, queue, play/pause, progress, volume, and track navigation using an HTML Audio element.
frontend/src/data/anime.ts: A static data file exporting a typed array of anime shows with metadata including title, episode count, genre, description, and watch URL, covering classic and older titles.
frontend/src/data/browserGames.ts: A static data file defining a typed interface and array of browser-playable mini-games with id, title, category, description, and emoji fields.
frontend/src/data/c-drama.ts: A static data file exporting a typed array of Chinese drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/fallbackMusic.ts: Defines a curated list of fallback music tracks (FALLBACK_TRACKS) using public-domain or Creative Commons recordings from the Internet Archive, covering genres like Jazz and Classical, used when the Jamendo API is unavailable.
frontend/src/data/games.ts: Exports a typed list of classic/retro games (mostly DOS and NES titles from archive.org) with metadata including title, category, description, and URL, auto-assigned numeric IDs.
frontend/src/data/generatedMusic.ts: Provides deterministic seed-based utilities and large genre-specific data pools (artist names, title words, groups) for procedurally generating fake music track metadata across 50+ genres including K-Pop, Hip-Hop, and more.
frontend/src/data/j-drama.ts: Exports a typed array of Japanese drama shows (jDramaShows) with title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/k-drama.ts: Exports a typed array of Korean drama shows (kDramaShows) with title, episode count, genre, description, and streaming watch URLs from platforms like Netflix and Viki.
frontend/src/data/movies.ts: Defines a Movie interface and exports a large array of public-domain classic films with titles, years, genres, synopses, and Internet Archive watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/music.ts: Defines a Track interface and exports a collection of public-domain music tracks (classical and other genres) with artist info and Internet Archive audio URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChat.ts: Custom React hook managing chat state for an AI assistant named Kitschy, handling message history, sending messages via aiService, loading state, and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useMovieSearch.ts: Custom React hook that fetches movies from TMDB with debounced search, genre filtering, pagination, and load-more support.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicSearch.ts: Custom React hook for searching and paginating music tracks via a music API service, with debounced query input, genre filtering, fallback data handling, and load-more functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/usePersonalization.ts: React hook that manages background texture and overlay opacity personalization settings, persisting them to localStorage with validation against a list of valid texture names.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaylists.ts: React hook providing full CRUD operations for user playlists (create, delete, rename, add/remove songs), persisting playlist data to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating radio station favorites and song favorites via a canister actor, with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useSongFavorites.ts: React Query hooks specifically for song favorites (get, add, remove) via a canister actor, with error handling and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for the dark theme color system, and styles scrollbars and audio elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AIAssistant.tsx: AI chat page component featuring a message thread UI with user/bot bubbles, a textarea input, and a clear history button, powered by the useChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/AlbumDetail.tsx: Page component displaying songs for a specific artist/album combination, with a play-all button and a grid of SongCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Anime.tsx: Anime browsing page with search and genre filter controls, rendering a filtered grid of ShowCard components from a static anime dataset.
frontend/src/pages/ArtistDetail.tsx: Displays a detail page for a specific artist, grouping their songs by album with play-all functionality and links to individual album pages.
frontend/src/pages/CDrama.tsx: Renders a searchable, genre-filterable grid of Chinese drama shows using data from a static list and a reusable ShowCard component.
frontend/src/pages/Favorites.tsx: Shows the user's favorited songs fetched via a custom hook, reconstructing Song objects from stored IDs/labels and supporting play-all via the music player context.
frontend/src/pages/Games.tsx: Renders a searchable, category-filterable grid of browser games and opens the selected game in a modal using mapped React game components.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero section and navigation cards linking to the Games, Movies, and Music sections of the app.
frontend/src/pages/JDrama.tsx: Renders a searchable, genre-filterable grid of Japanese drama shows using static data and a reusable ShowCard component.
frontend/src/pages/KDrama.tsx: Displays a filterable, searchable grid of K-Drama shows using static data, with genre select and search input controls rendering ShowCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Movies.tsx: Movies browse page that uses TMDB API via a custom hook to display an infinite-scroll grid of movie cards with trailer links, search, and genre filtering.
frontend/src/pages/Music.tsx: Music browse page with infinite scroll, search/genre filtering via useMusicSearch hook, and a play-all button that queues songs through the MusicPlayerContext.
frontend/src/pages/Personalization.tsx: Settings page allowing users to choose a background wallpaper texture and overlay opacity, persisted via the usePersonalization hook.
frontend/src/pages/PlaylistDetail.tsx: Shows the songs within a single playlist (looked up by ID), supporting play-all and individual song removal, with navigation back to the playlists list.
frontend/src/pages/Playlists.tsx: Playlists management page that lets users create, rename, delete, and play playlists stored via the usePlaylists hook.
frontend/src/services/aiService.ts: Sends chat messages to the Mistral-7B-Instruct model via HuggingFace Inference API, building a prompt with conversation history and a system persona ('Kitschy'). Falls back to hardcoded keyword-based responses if the API call fails.
frontend/src/services/musicApiService.ts: Fetches royalty-free music tracks from the Jamendo API with genre/search filtering, normalizing results into a common ApiSong shape. Falls back to curated hardcoded tracks from fallbackMusic when the API fails or returns empty results.
frontend/src/services/tmdbService.ts: Wraps the TMDb v3 REST API to fetch popular, trending, genre-filtered, and searched movies, mapping results to a TmdbMovie interface including poster URLs and YouTube trailer links.
frontend/src/types/music.ts: Defines the core TypeScript interfaces Song (track metadata including duration) and Playlist (named collection of song IDs).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions to read URL query parameters from both standard query strings and hash-based routes, with helpers to persist values in sessionStorage and remove sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the theme with oklch-based semantic color tokens, custom fonts (Bebas Neue, Inter), zero border-radius, silver box shadows, and enabling the animate and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the Kitsch-io project's current state (version 3), documenting the known issue of music tracks not loading and three existing fix features targeting the Jamendo API integration, hardcoded fallback tracks, and the useMusicSearch hook.
